evidence.description: ### Average Sale Price of Apartments in Dubai Marina Based on recent stats from Bayut, the average sale price for apartments in Dubai Marina is AED 1,674 per square foot. This represents a notable 14.5% increase from the previous year, highlighting the area's growing popularity and limited apartment supply. ### Types of Apartments for Sale in Dubai Marina Dubai Marina has a wide range of apartment options, including studios, one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and three-bedroom apartments, including luxe duplexes and penthouses. Prices vary by size and location, for example, one-bedroom apartments average around AED 1,670 per square foot, while two-bedroom units average about AED 1,617 per square foot. The unit size, a critical aspect, also varies according to the type. [...] ### Costs Associated with Buying an Apartment The cost of purchasing an apartment in Dubai Marina varies with size and location. According to property finder, the average asking price is around AED 1,450,000 for a one-bedroom apartment and can reach up to AED 2,150,000 for a two-bedroom unit. Cost of Living and Investing Living in Dubai Marina is relatively expensive compared to other areas in Dubai but remains cheaper than many Western cities. A one-bedroom apartment in Dubai Marina costs between 90000 and 110000 AED per year, while a two-bedroom apartment costs between 128000 and 157000 AED per year, according to Dubai Land Department data.
